description: This source file defines the PredicateParser interface for parsing predicate expressions into Abstract Syntax Trees (AST) in the Eclipse Ditto project. It specifies a contract that implementing classes must follow, including the parse method that takes a String input and returns a RootNode AST.

classes.name: PredicateParser
classes.description: Interface specifying the contract for a predicate parser that converts input strings into ASTs.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the input string to produce a RootNode representing the AST of the predicate expression.
